text:
## Response Timeframes (FCA Requirements)  
**Maximum Response Times:**  
| Complaint Type | Timeframe | Escalation |
|---|---|---|
| Simple (resolve quickly) | 1 business day | Manager if escalated |
| Standard | 8 calendar days | Director if unresolved |
| Complex | 8 weeks (FCA extension) | FCA notification if exceeded |  
**8-Week Clock:**
- Starts: When complaint received
- Stops: When response sent to customer
- Can be extended 8 weeks if: Complex investigation justified, customer agrees

properties.core_policy_statement: The bank must respond to customer complaints within defined timeframes based on complexity: simple complaints within 1 business day, standard complaints within 8 calendar days, and complex complaints within 8 weeks, with potential extension of the 8-week clock if complex investigation is justified and customer agrees.
properties.scope_summary: Applies to all customer complaints requiring response. Excludes complaints that do not require investigation.

properties.key_obligation: Banks must respond to customer complaints within specified timeframes: 1 business day for simple complaints, 8 calendar days for standard complaints, and 8 weeks for complex complaints, with potential extension of the 8-week clock if justified.
properties.consequences_of_breach: FCA notification required if response timeframe exceeded; regulatory enforcement action possible

properties.risk_definition: Failure to respond to customer complaints within FCA-mandated timeframes based on complaint complexity
examples: Simple complaint not resolved within 1 business day
Standard complaint not resolved within 8 calendar days
Complex complaint not resolved within 8 weeks
required_response: Escalation to appropriate authority (Manager, Director, or FCA)
reporting_obligation: FCA notification if response timeframe exceeded
